consequence.statement: Environments that enable the `ValidateCAA` feature gate keep working in cert-manager 1.17 but a deprecation warning is printed when the gate is enabled; the gate will be removed in cert-manager v1.18, and the release notes advise operators manually enabling it to stop.
consequence.remediation: Stop manually enabling the `ValidateCAA` feature gate; it is scheduled for removal in cert-manager v1.18.

assertion.statement: The cert-manager `ValidateCAA` feature gate is deprecated: in 1.17 it still works but prints a warning when enabled, and it will be removed in cert-manager v1.18.
